title: Understanding Spectral Clustering
text: In spectral clustering, we first construct a graph where each point is a vertex. The weight of the edge between two vertices is a function of the Euclidean distance between them. Consider how the distance affects the weight of the edge.

title: Finding the Smallest Edge Weight
text: To find the edge with the smallest weight, look for the pair of points with the smallest Euclidean distance. This distance will determine the weight of the edge between them.

title: Identifying the Closest Points
text: Which pair of points has the smallest Euclidean distance?
